checks_run.limitations: These are structural/content and independent fixture checks, not FileMaker syntax, script configuration, model inference, cryptographic engine, OCR, SQL engine or provider integration tests.

validation.outputs: Expected illustrations or explicitly synthetic fixtures; not recorded FileMaker output. Pure arithmetic and encoding expectations may be checked independently, which does not validate FileMaker execution.
validation.script_outlines: Bracketed script steps describe configuration, not pasteable calculation syntax. Angle-bracket placeholders require deliberate environment setup.
security: AI accounts, providers, models, endpoints, layouts and secrets are explicit environment inputs; provider-backed outlines would transmit data if configured and run, but were not executed.
Evaluate syntax/error checks are not authorization or sandboxing. Custom functions and plug-ins can have side effects; even an error-check evaluation executes the expression.
UI closure/navigation, exports, field writes and QR URL opening are unexecuted operations requiring review.
Keys/passwords are secret-store inputs, not embedded production secrets.

attribution.author: Darrin Southern
attribution.changes: Retain CadenceUX synthesis and factual coverage; independently replace all concrete examples, including secondary patterns and inline examples; document fixtures, mathematical expectations, corrections and untested runtime dependencies. No original example code is reproduced in this manifest.

scope.manifest_path_note: Development-only manifest in the adaptation repository's docs directory, alongside the other replacement manifests.
scope.range_convention: Inclusive 1-based source line ranges, including fence lines where applicable. Each examples entry identifies an original block or inline run, and its replacement teaching content. Replacement section is the same exact heading as section unless target_section is supplied. Source ranges intentionally contain no source code. Review status applies to every examples entry within its record.

review_status_definitions.reviewed_math: Manually reviewed against source teaching purposes; independent Python arithmetic oracle used for mathematical expectations, not FileMaker execution.
review_status_definitions.reviewed_fixture: Manually reviewed for teaching-purpose coverage and explicit hypothetical setup; runtime behavior is expected only and requires FileMaker verification.
review_status_definitions.reviewed_language: Manually reviewed linguistic/calendar expectations; IME output, traditional glyph choices and FileMaker formatting require runtime confirmation.
review_status_definitions.reviewed_device: Manually reviewed API semantics and original teaching purpose; outputs are hardware-dependent placeholders, no device observations.

verification.observed: Python Decimal/math/statistics calculations and static file checks only; no FileMaker, Go, IME, database, layout, add-on, beacon, sensor or container results were observed.

successful_local_assertions.checks: JSON parsing; exact full heading sequence equality; balanced fences; attribution and TOC presence; every source fence block covered by an inclusive source range; valid replacement section locators and review statuses; zero identical complete fenced example blocks. Numerical assertions directly model the new examples, including Decimal finance, rounding, trig, all heading quadrants/axes, Haversine, aggregate/repeating arithmetic, two calendar checks and selected Unicode width checks.

verification.oracle: Python 3 standard library: Decimal at precision 60 for finance and transcendental decimal checks, Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP for ties, math for trigonometry and Haversine, statistics for sample/population measures.
limitations: A mathematical oracle validates the stated mathematical model, not FileMaker expression parsing, evaluation order, precision, field reference propagation or platform support.
SetPrecision's exact final digits must be confirmed in FileMaker; mathematical reference values are independently calculated.
Random is specified by range only; no stochastic quality or actual draws were tested.
Japanese expected text is not an observed FileMaker/IME result. Furigana readings and traditional glyph variants are labelled candidates.
Paths, actual internal record IDs, add-on metadata, object UUIDs, persistent entries, container types and device readings need real environment fixtures.
Persistent-data empty namespace and trailing blank-line iteration require runtime testing; the sentinel probe assumes a literal question mark is not stored as a legitimate value.
This is a source-example replacement review, not legal clearance or a claim of exhaustive FileMaker behavioral testing.
